gitImport.title: Git history import
gitImport.hint: Pick repositories and configure each one: branch, period, commit limit. The AI groups commits into completed work items: fully matching open tasks get closed, partially done ones get their plan steps ticked. Already imported commits are skipped; new work lands at the top of the Done column.

plugin.title: Claude Code plugin for this project
plugin.regenerateHint: usually unnecessary: it refreshes itself after indexing and decision edits
plugin.intro: The plugin connects the project MCP server (knowledge map, kanban, RLM queries, work log) and skills generated from the analysis — architecture, business logic, workflow, task briefing, how to search — to your Claude Code. Once installed, Claude in the terminal “knows” the project and can manage its tasks.
plugin.skillsHint: Generated from the knowledge map automatically — after every indexing run and whenever decisions change. Claude Code picks them up by itself.
plugin.skillsEmpty: They appear once the project is indexed
plugin.tools: MCP tools of the projectai server
plugin.toolsHint: Available both to the built-in chat and to Claude Code once the plugin is installed.
plugin.installHint: The plugin can live in this project only — then it loads when Claude Code runs in the project directory and stays out of the way elsewhere. The setting is written to {path}; other keys in that file are left alone.
plugin.global: Install globally (for every project on this machine)
plugin.global3: This writes the plugin into ~/.claude/settings.json, so it is visible in every Claude Code session on the machine.

access.title: Tool access
access.hint: What the AI may use in the built-in chat and what external Claude Code gets through the plugin. Technical operations (re-indexing, git import) are off for the plugin by default — the external AI works on the project, it does not run the system. Applies at the next AI session start.

decisions.added: Decision recorded — every future briefing and verification will take it into account.
decisions.title: Project decisions
decisions.intro: Things you cannot read from the code: what counts as right now and what was abandoned. Code usually lags behind decisions: without a note like “role ORGANIZER was removed, now MANAGER + permissions” the AI finds leftovers of the old approach and files them as a bug; with it, the AI understands this is a deliberate transition and finishes the migration instead of rolling it back. Both people and the AI write here: tell Claude Code “we changed the approach” and it records it via record_decision. Decisions are also extracted automatically from calls and documents.
decisions.empty: Nothing yet — add one by hand, ask the AI in Claude Code to record it (record_decision) or upload a call recording: decisions are extracted automatically.
